casebody.head_matter:
Matthew ASTORGA, petitioner,
v.
KANSAS.
No. 12-7568.
Supreme Court of the United States
June 24, 2013.
On petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Kansas. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the Supreme Court of Kansas for further consideration in light of Alleyne v. United States, --- U.S. ----, 133 S.Ct. 2151, --- L.Ed. ---- (2013).
